Flow.description: Automatically creates a Contract and Order when an Opportunity is marked as Closed Won. Requires a Primary (Synced) Quote on the Opportunity. Contract is created with CONTRACT_HEADER_ONLY (no prices or discounts). For Amend/Renew/Cancel quotes, Order EffectiveDate and EndDate are set from the first QLI with both dates populated. For Amendment, the existing Contract EndDate is extended to match QLI EndDate (if needed) before Order creation so ContractId is preserved on the Order. New Business sets Order.EffectiveDate from Est_Start_Date__c and Order.EndDate from Contract.EndDate (calculated by Update End Date to the last day of the month), then calls UpdateOrderProductEndDate Apex to sync Order Product end dates.

formulas.description: Cumulative ContractTerm from the Contract's own (original) StartDate to the amendment's new EndDate — NOT the amendment Quote's own Contract_Term_Months__c, which is only that amendment's incremental term counted from its own StartDate and would otherwise get copied verbatim onto the Contract, producing a ContractTerm inconsistent with the Contract's actual StartDate/EndDate span.
